preamble: Seven across and seven down clues have solutions of a kind and contain no definition.

clue.text: An aspiring knight has no say in essay papers

indicators.note: to have none of something is to go without it, so those letters are taken away

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A would-be knight is struck dumb in his written exam papers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has no say' sounds like being denied a voice, but it asks you to strip those three letters out of the word beside it. A quire is a stationer's measure of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically a squire or esquire attended a knight and was in training to become one himself.
